technical_and_design_decisions: Target platform is Spring XD (1.x line) running on Spring Boot and Java 17+, with Docker-based container deployment of XD admin/container nodes.

U1: Use Docker's native container linking and environment variable mechanisms; expose new configuration knobs (linking/binding attributes, env vars) through the existing XD YAML configuration model (servers.yml and container launch scripts) so that connections to Rabbit, Redis, Zookeeper, Hadoop, and Mongo can be declared per container.

U2: Implement service discovery on top of Zookeeper (already used by XD for coordination), behind a pluggable service-discovery SPI so alternatives (e.g., etcd/Consul) can be added later; containers register themselves and resolve peers through the registry.

U3: Provide a canonical Dockerfile per XD component plus a Jenkins CI pipeline stage that builds images, runs smoke/integration tests inside containers, tags images per environment, and pushes them to an internal registry.

U4: Documentation will be based on hands-on validation of XD running as Marathon applications on a Mesos cluster, including Marathon app definitions, constraints, health checks, and resource sizing recommendations.

U5: Upgrade Spring Boot to the latest version compatible with the XD release line, managed via dependency BOM alignment, followed by execution of the full existing regression/integration test suite to detect side effects.

U6: Implement partitioning as a user-supplied strategy option on the RDBMS-to-HDFS ingest job, built on Spring Batch partitioning (e.g., column-range based partitioner) so ingest can be parallelized across worker threads/containers.
U7: Implement the HDFS source as a standard XD stream source module using Spring for Apache Hadoop (SHDP) HDFS APIs, with options for directory, file pattern, and polling/scanning behavior.

U8: Add a 'commitInterval' property to servers.yml with per-job override capability, applied to all out-of-the-box jobs that support partitioning; the property overrides the framework default commit interval at job launch.
All code changes follow the existing project conventions: Maven build, JUnit/Mockito unit tests, Spring integration tests, and Asciidoc/Markdown documentation in the reference guide.
assumptions: A single developer performs all work; estimates are effort in work-hours, not elapsed calendar time.
An existing Spring XD codebase, build environment, and source repository are available; this increment extends it rather than creating a new product.
Test infrastructure for Docker, a Mesos/Marathon cluster, Hadoop/HDFS, Rabbit, Redis, Zookeeper, and Mongo is available for development and testing.
Estimates include analysis/design, implementation, unit and integration testing, and user documentation per story, plus overall integration and release preparation.
Defect fixing for issues found during testing is included in each activity's estimate; only reasonable rework is assumed.
No external dependencies on other teams; CI system (Jenkins) and Docker registry already exist and only need configuration for this increment.
The specification's lack of detail on exact service-discovery technology, Boot target version, and partitioning algorithm is resolved by the design decisions listed above.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Design Docker container linking configuration model
activities.activity_description: Analyze XD container configuration model and Docker linking/env-var conventions; design how linking/binding attributes and environment variables are declared and propagated to XD containers for external services (Rabbit, Redis, Zookeeper, Hadoop, Mongo).

activities.activity_name: U1 - Implement linking/binding attributes and environment variables support
activities.activity_description: Implement configuration parsing and propagation of Docker links and environment variables into XD container startup and module resolution for external services.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Unit and integration testing of container linking
activities.activity_description: Write unit tests and integration tests validating container linking and env-var configuration against Rabbit, Redis, Zookeeper, Hadoop, and Mongo instances.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Document linking/binding attributes and environment variables
activities.activity_description: Write reference documentation with pointers to supported linking/binding attributes and environment variables.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Design service discovery integration
activities.activity_description: Design the service discovery approach (Zookeeper-backed registry behind a pluggable SPI), registration/discovery lifecycle, and cluster communication behavior for XD containers.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Implement service discovery support
activities.activity_description: Implement container self-registration, service lookup, and configuration so processes and services in the cluster can find and talk to one another via the discovery service.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Test service discovery in a clustered deployment
activities.activity_description: Unit and multi-node integration tests covering registration, discovery, failure/rejoin scenarios, and inter-service communication.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Document service discovery configuration
activities.activity_description: Document how to configure and operate service discovery for Docker XD containers.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Define Dockerfiles and image composition
activities.activity_description: Create canonical Dockerfiles for XD components baking in required components/configurations, defining base images, layers, and build arguments.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Implement CI pipeline for image build, test, and deploy
activities.activity_description: Implement Jenkins CI pipeline stages that build Docker images, run containerized tests, tag images per environment, and deploy/push them to target environments and registry.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Verify CI pipeline across environments
activities.activity_description: Run end-to-end verification of the CI pipeline producing and deploying images to multiple environments; fix pipeline issues found.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Hands-on validation of XD on Mesos with Marathon
activities.activity_description: Deploy an XD cluster on Mesos using Marathon, experiment with app definitions, constraints, health checks, scaling, and resource sizing to derive sound recommendations.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Write Mesos/Marathon deployment recommendations document
activities.activity_description: Author the recommended-practices document for deploying an XD cluster using Mesos with the Marathon Framework, including sample Marathon app definitions.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Analyze Spring Boot dependency upgrade impacts
activities.activity_description: Inventory current Boot-managed dependencies, identify the target Boot version, and analyze API/behavior changes that could affect existing XD functionality.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Perform Boot upgrade and regression testing
activities.activity_description: Apply the dependency upgrades, resolve compilation/behavioral issues, and run the full regression/integration test suite to confirm no side effects on existing functionality.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Design data partitioning strategy option
activities.activity_description: Design the user-supplied partitioning strategy option (e.g., column-range partitioner) for parallelizing RDBMS-to-HDFS ingest, including job parameters and validation.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Implement partitioning strategy for RDBMS-to-HDFS ingest
activities.activity_description: Implement the partitioning strategy using Spring Batch partitioning so ingest from RDBMS to HDFS can be executed in parallel partitions.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Test partitioned ingest
activities.activity_description: Unit and integration tests covering correctness, parallelism, partition boundaries, and data completeness of RDBMS-to-HDFS ingest with the strategy option enabled.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Design HDFS source module
activities.activity_description: Design the HDFS stream source module: options (directory, file pattern, scanning behavior), data flow into the stream, and error handling.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Implement HDFS source module
activities.activity_description: Implement the XD source module that ingests data directly from HDFS using Spring for Apache Hadoop HDFS APIs.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Test HDFS source module
activities.activity_description: Unit and integration tests against a live HDFS cluster covering file discovery, ingestion correctness, formats, and failure handling.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Document HDFS source module
activities.activity_description: Document module options and usage examples for ingesting data directly from HDFS.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Implement commit-interval override via servers.yml
activities.activity_description: Add a commitInterval property to servers.yml and wire it so it overrides the default commit interval for all out-of-the-box jobs that support partitioning.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Test and document commit-interval override
activities.activity_description: Verify the override applies to all partition-capable OOTB jobs with different data volumes; document the new servers.yml property.

activities.activity_name: Increment-wide integration and system testing
activities.activity_description: Integrate all story deliverables, run end-to-end system tests of the complete increment (Dockerized XD with discovery, CI-built images, upgraded Boot, new modules/jobs), and fix integration defects.

activities.activity_name: Release preparation
activities.activity_description: Final build verification, release notes, version/tag updates, and packaging of the software increment.
